summary: A test or eval: expected values from an independent source, the repo's override mechanism, fixture isolation for anything with network, DB or a browser, run alone and inside the CI-filtered suite.

required_inputs.name: subject
required_inputs.description: The function, route or flow under test, by path

required_inputs.name: oracle
required_inputs.description: Where the expected values come from: a spec, a fixture, a hand calculation, a recorded response

required_inputs.name: runner
required_inputs.description: pytest, vitest, playwright, jest, node:test, unittest

required_inputs.name: authorization
required_inputs.description: For a paid or live run: who authorized it and the cost ceiling

checklist.rule: Expected values come from an independent source, never from running the code under test and pasting its output
checklist.because: A test that asserts whatever the function returned passes forever; the packages-are-formatting-only test in Flex was written against CLAUDE.md, not the packages

checklist.rule: A dependency the framework registers (FastAPI Depends, a DI container) is replaced through the framework's mechanism, never a module patch, because the framework ignores the patch. Every other substitution uses the adapter's declared override_mechanism (vi.mock at a module boundary, fixtures, monkeypatched provider fakes) and the test shows no real provider or service is reached
checklist.because: r3cruit3r mocker.patch of a FastAPI dependency never took effect and the tests called the real API (commit 063bbcb); quadratus's offline provider fakes are monkeypatch-based by design and reach no vendor, so a blanket ban on module patches would reject the approved Q1 to Q4 regressions

checklist.rule: Anything that needs network, a database or a browser is fixture-isolated, or listed in the ignore list with a reason
checklist.because: r3cruit3r CI ignores 17 files that need Redis or live services; War Room DB tests only under a 127.0.0.1 DSN; LINDA excludes the playwright demo test

checklist.rule: The file runs alone and inside the CI-filtered full run; both tails are pasted
checklist.because: A test that passes alone and is skipped by the CI filter proves nothing; a green CI does not mean the whole suite passes (r3cruit3r reviewer)

checklist.rule: A guard test proves it can fail: a seeded violation or a negative fixture is asserted as a finding
checklist.because: Flex CLAUDE.md: a check that can pass while the thing it guards is broken is worse than none; the L1 guard was shown red on the old tree first

checklist.rule: A paid or live run requires a named authorization and a cost ceiling in the input, and counts refusals separately
checklist.because: War Room evals README: paid evaluations require authorization; keys only from evals/.env; refusals are not failures
detect-secrets pre-commit and the ship-check secret grep both trip on them

checklist.rule: No wall-clock, random or ordering dependence without a seed or a freeze
checklist.because: Flex booking tests once depended on the current date and failed at month end

checklist.rule: A new test or script file is included by the typecheck or lint configuration the repo runs
checklist.because: Flex tsconfig.scripts.json lists scripts by name; an unlisted script rots unseen

done_output: tail of the file run alone
tail of the CI-filtered full run
the negative case that proves the test can fail
authorization and ceiling for any paid run, or none
stop_conditions: the subject needs a live system and no fixture path exists
a paid run is requested without authorization and a ceiling
the repo has no override mechanism for the dependency

adapter_fields.name: runner
adapter_fields.description: The test runner and its invocation

adapter_fields.name: ignore_list_path
adapter_fields.description: Where CI's ignore or skip list lives

adapter_fields.name: override_mechanism
adapter_fields.description: The substitution mechanism tests use and how a test proves no real provider is reached: app.dependency_overrides (FastAPI), vi.mock at a module boundary (Vitest), fixtures, or monkeypatched provider fakes with a no-network assertion (quadratus)

adapter_fields.name: paid_gate
adapter_fields.description: How a paid run is authorized and capped

adapter_fields.name: local_db_dsn_rule
adapter_fields.description: The rule for database tests, for example 127.0.0.1 only
